reason: Provides seven agent tools for searching, reading, inspecting, validating, repairing, recording errors in, and ingesting content into a local LLM-Wiki knowledge base through a Python CLI.

summaries.zh: 通过七个代理工具检索、阅读、统计、校验、修复并向本地 LLM-Wiki 知识库导入内容。
summaries.en: Provides seven agent tools to search, read, inspect, validate, repair, and ingest content into a local LLM-Wiki knowledge base.

capabilities: Reads wiki pages and indexes from a configured local directory
Writes and repairs wiki files and indexes
Invokes the LLM-Wiki Python CLI through subprocesses
Optionally sends ingest and finalization requests to an OpenAI-compatible LLM API
